design: R1-3: 3 independent metric-free paraphrases of the instruction VOICE/TAIL (experiments/ablation/prompt_paraphrase.py), deepseek-v4, 200 briefs, 1 seed each, R1-6 normalized, scored with the canonical paired machinery
reading: The mode-level conclusion is robust to wording: every paraphrase lands deepseek instruction at parity-or-beyond on B_n. The landing POINT is not: all three paraphrases cluster at -0.026..-0.030 (one significant), ~0.03 from the canonical wording's +0.000, comparable to the size of many reported mode effects. Mode ordering claims should carry a wording-sensitivity bound; the aim wobble is the same phenomenon as the cross-model scatter.
caveats: paraphrase legs are 1-seed (canonical is 3-seed seed-averaged); one model family
